author: FilmCow
description:
The complete "Llamas with Hats" series on Blu-ray and DVD. Each copy comes hand-signed by me:
http://filmcow.etsy.com

The disc includes:
Llamas with Hats: Episodes 1-12
Llamas with Hats: Epilogue
Commentary for the above
Llamas with Hats 1-12: Re-Cut for Brand Conscientiousness
Llamas with Hats: Lonely is the Night
Llamas with Hats: 15 Year Anniversary
Which Llama Are You?
The “Llamas with Hats” Guy's Final Moments
Elsa Reacts to Llamas with Hats
Llamas with Hats: Cruise Catastrophe Ad
Llamas with Hats: Hungry for Hands Ad

The discs are region free.

(Note: if you got the Blu-ray or DVD from the Epilogue's Kickstarter two years ago, you can skip this release! The only major difference between the two releases is the Kickstarter disc also included a couple of campaign-specific promotional videos.)
title: Llamas with Hats on Blu-ray & DVD (Signed!)
